easyPrerequisites: You have not created any tokens this turn.
description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of token copies of Exalted Sunborn equal to twice your life total due to Moonlit Meditation.
Whenever you create one or more tokens, you will instead create 2^X times that many tokens, where X is the number of Exalted Sunborns you control.
